sectionInEnglish: Le ngxenye ishintshile selokhu yahunyushwa, ngakho ikhonjiswa ngesiNgisi kuze kube yilapho ukuhunyushwa kwayo kulungiswa.

list.title: Imihlahlandlela
list.lead: Imihlahlandlela ngolimi olulula yababumbi abasha: kusukela kulokho okuyi-glaze kuya ekuyishiseni, nokugcina wonke umuntu ephephile endleleni.
list.note: Le mihlahlandlela iqoqa lokho okushicilelwa abakhiqizi, izinhlangano zokuphepha nababumbi abanolwazi, nemithombo ekugcineni kowodwa ngamunye. Iyisiqalo, ayithathi indawo yamashidi edatha yokuphepha okokwakha kwakho, incwadi yemiyalelo ye-kiln yakho noma imithetho yendawo.

glazingBasics.title: Izisekelo ze-glaze
glazingBasics.text: Yini i-glaze, incibilika kanjani, nawo wonke amagama ozowahlangabeza eresiphi noma esikhwameni, echaziwe.

makingAGlaze.title: Indlela yokwenza i-glaze
makingAGlaze.text: Ukuthenga, ukugcina, ukukala, ukuxuba nokuhlunga i-glaze, bese uyihlola futhi ugcina amarekhodi.

safeMixing.title: Ukuxuba ngokuphepha nomoya ohlanzekile
safeMixing.text: Uthuli, ama-respirator, ukuhlanza, okokwakha okudinga ukunakekelwa kakhulu, nokukhipha umoya we-kiln.

homeSafety.title: Ungawadliseli ushevu umndeni wakho
homeSafety.text: Ukubumba ekhaya nezingane nezilwane zasekhaya: ukugcina, uthuli, i-kiln, nokuthi wenzeni uma kukhona okugwinyiwe.

firing.title: Ukushisa ku-kiln elula
firing.text: Ama-cone, ama-kiln sitter nezishintshi zesandla, namashejuli okushisa i-bisque ne-glaze.

learnWithJohnBritt.title: Funda ngesifundo samahhala se-glaze sikaJohn Britt
learnWithJohnBritt.text: Isifundo sakhe samahhala samavidiyo ku-YouTube, iyunithi ngeyunithi, nemihlahlandlela yethu okufanele uyifunde nezivivinyo okufanele uzizame ku-Glazecalc. NgesiNgisi.

teachingGlazeCalculation.title: Ukufundisa ukubala i-glaze
teachingGlazeCalculation.text: Izifundo ezi-6 zekilasi noma iqembu lokufunda, kusukela kuma-tile e-triaxial kuya ku-UMF ixazululwa ngazo zombili izindlela, namashidi okusebenza okuphrinta.

cones.title: Ishadi lama-cone
cones.text: Ama-cone e-Orton nawe-SK namazinga awo okushisa ku-°C naku-°F, nalapho isibalo ngasinye sivela khona.

materials.title: Okokwakha okujwayelekile
materials.text: Okokwakha ngakunye kumtapo nokuhlaziywa kwakho kwama-oxide, umthelela wakho ku-unity formula nezingozi zakho.

famous.title: Ama-glaze adumile
famous.text: Ama-glaze aziwa emhlabeni wonke, ngalinye lenziwe ngokokwakha kwendabuko kwendawo yalo, ne-UMF yalo nohlobo olwenziwe ngokokwakha okuthengiswa lapho ukhona.

stull.title: Ishadi le-Stull: i-silica ngokumelene ne-alumina ku-UMF
stull.keyBright: Umugqa wamachashazi: lapho ama-glaze ka-Stull ayekhanya kakhulu khona.
stull.keyCrazed: Imigqa ewelanayo: lapho aba ne-crazing khona.
stull.note: Kungumhlahlandlela, hhayi isibikezelo. U-R. T. Stull (Transactions of the American Ceramic Society, 1912) washisa cishe ku-cone 11 ama-flux engaguquki ku-0.3 K₂O no-0.7 CaO; amanye ama-flux nokunye ukushisa kuhambisa izindawo, futhi i-glaze engacwebezeli (matte) ngoba nje ingashiswanga ngokwanele isengabonakala njengecwebezelayo eshadini. Izindawo zinjengoba i-Glazy izidweba.
stull.inGuide: I-silica (SiO₂) ngokuvundla, kusukela cishe ku-1 kuya ku-7, ne-alumina (Al₂O₃) ngokuphakama, kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-1, zombili ziphuma ku-UMF. Izingxenye ezimise okwesigaxa zivuleka zisuka kwesobunxele: engancibilikanga phezulu kwesobunxele, bese kuba yi-matte, bese kuba yi-matte encane. Ingxenye engafakwanga umthunzi ngakwesokudla sazo icwebezela, futhi umugqa wamachashazi kuyo ukhombisa lapho ama-glaze ka-Stull ayecwebezela kakhulu. Engashiswanga ngokwanele ingezansi kwesokudla, ine-alumina encane ne-silica eningi. Imigqa ewelanayo, ezansi eshadini nangakwesobunxele salo, ikhombisa lapho izivivinyo zakhe zathola i-crazing.
